searchResults.title: ABOUT VIFON
searchResults.highlight:
Being one of the first companies that lays the foundation for instant food industry in VN, etc
...
As one of the units that laid the foundation for the establishment of Vietnam's instant food industry, VIFON has become a familiar brand and associated with consumers through many products of instant noodles and spices. Located on an area of ​​67,000 m2, with a large production capacity, and a team of enthusiastic employees, the company has constantly modernized equipment and invested heavily in research to create more products. High quality products.
...
VIFON always prioritizes the food safety standard. The products are committed not to use synthetic colors. VIFON’s products not only comply with all the regulations of food quality in Vietnam but also get the approval from many countries which have strict quality management standards, such as the US, Australia, Japan, and European countries.
...
Consecutively improve products’ quality in order to fully satisfy consumers’ increasing demands in Vietnam and international market in the field of instant food manufacture.
...
Focus on developing the domestic market to grow market share and position of the pioneer manufacturer in the field of instant food.

searchResults.title: vifon
searchResults.highlight:
VIFON is a Food and Beverage Services company. Vifon is a company that specializes in the production and export of food products such as rice, meat, and dairy. They have a wide range of products available in the domestic and imported markets. Vifon also offers online shopping, news and promotions, and a library for their products. VIFON employs 58 people (+15.8% YoY, +23 people), founded in 1963. Headquartered in Vietnam. Its workforce is distributed across Vietnam, Switzerland, New Zealand, and Poland.

# Exhibitors 

 

# VIFON CORPORATION

 Hall: North Hall 13 Stand: DG-E40 

 VIFON Corporation, established in 1963, is one of Vietnam’s leading food manufacturers specializing in instant rice noodles, pho, and other convenient food products. With over 60 years of experience, VIFON has become a trusted household brand, pioneering the instant food industry in Vietnam. The company’s products are currently exported to more than 100 countries worldwide, meeting international standards such as ISO, HACCP, and Halal. VIFON is committed to delivering authentic Vietnamese flavors through high-quality, safe, and convenient products that meet global consumer expectations. Combining traditional recipes with modern technology, VIFON continuously innovates to promote Vietnamese cuisine on the global stage.
